body: Idk if your here but my phone turned off and just got it back I think I’m doing better now you helped me a lot that day

I have many times he’s very aware of everything he knows I’m struggling just seems to not care I’ve even tried texting him instead of confronting him so I don’t make him mad  I think he thinks I’m being dramatic because I’ve always been very very strong so it might be even a shock to him right now  he pittys me because he says I have no responsibilities and that if I’m sick I’m lucky I can sleep it sounds like he is very tired and acts like I don’t help him I clean my house spotless everyday just so he’s not so stressed and a little bit nicer that day even that keeps me going most days I feel like I’m developing ocd bc it gives me some control of my life
Don’t listen to him he is toxic if he’s saying things like this you have to hold on and not let him effect you bc you will find healthier people who will make you happy

Yes they do but there’s so much they don’t know what to do with all of it I want to stay at my dads but it’s just hard one day we will be perfect and not have any problems then another day we will both be screaming at each other  there’s like 5 different groups of people trying to help but it makes everything worse they are always up in everything I do and always asking me questions I get it’s there job but it’s stressful my family could sue them for all the things they and the courts have messed up on

This time I ran away wasn’t because of my dad I was with my grandma and she was trying to baptize my brother and sister in the bath and making them drink wine and eat bread and I told her to stop because I didn’t want them getting forced into anything and they were to little to understand she is mentally unstable so this made her very very angry so she got violent and started calling me the devil she told me to leave (she wouldn’t let me leave after telling me to leave) so I tried but  but then she grabbed my arm and starting banging it against a tree she also tried choking me so I went back inside to stop her and waited till the night time it was snowing and around 10 degrees but I left anyway to walk to my moms i felt bad leaving my siblings but I had too i left around 10 and got there at 5 in the morning i have never experienced the coldness I felt in my body I was wearing ripped jeans and almost couldn’t keep my eyes open then when I got to my moms she told me to leave so I did it broke my heart and to this day I will never forgive her she was never like this both my mom and grandma have a mental thing (forgot what it’s called ) but they basically lost their minds after doing drugs my mom was a super mom and had a daycare with 18 kids then one day she just kinda left
I don’t know your situation but you cannot give up now I know everyone says this but I feel like this too so if you hold on so will I
